name: stress
description: This is a container image and wrapper script for stress: https://linux.die.net/man/1/stress This is for easy execution of stress without installing the package (e.g. on a distro where the package is not in the repos). It also includes a script which auto-identifies CPU count and free memory, then hogs it. You can obviously bypass it if you don't like how it works. This has some configuration options for level of the test and whether you want it to apply I/O load.

variables.name: Mode
variables.description: This is how intense you want the stress to be. It accepts the values heavy, medium, and light.

variables.name: Duration
variables.description: The duration of the stress test expressed like 2m for 2 minutes or 1h for 1 hour.

variables.name: I/O Threads
variables.description: The number of threads to run thrashing I/O on the container's disk. I don't really recommend you do this, I leave it set to 0.
